after.name: can. 750 §1
after.withheld:
a work of the Holy See later than 1929, over whose text Vatican City State Law
N. CXCVII of 2017 art. 2 asserts copyright by name; this project holds no licence

cited.basis: Article A divides c. 750 into two paragraphs, the first consisting of the text of the canon then in force and the second newly written, and prints the whole canon as it is thenceforth to read. So the canon that had no paragraphs ceases and two paragraphs begin. [Latin delivery, lines 53-55.]
